C0087.title: Maiduo Mall Pyramid Scheme Case
C0087.summary: Henan-based 'Maiduo Mall' operated a consumer rebate and multi-level commission model through its app. Users became agents after purchasing products and earned points-based rebates by promoting products and recruiting downline members. The platform was deemed by police to involve organizing and leading a pyramid scheme, and multiple agents were prosecuted.
